# Azure Resource Lookup — Inventory via Resource Graph

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's resource discovery skill: answer "what resources do I have?" by listing and finding any Azure resource type across subscriptions and resource groups, using dedicated MCP tools where they exist and Azure Resource Graph KQL queries (`az graph query`) where they don't — covering orphaned-resource discovery (unattached disks, unused NICs, idle IPs), tag-compliance audits and full resource inventories, with routing rules so App Service and Container Apps queries that lack list commands go through ARG. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: strictly read-only — Resource Graph cannot deploy or change anything; data has a slight delay, so it's not for real-time monitoring. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
